about_the_game:
Virum: Colony

After the catastrophe, Earth lies in ruins. The alien invaders drained the planet’s resources and left behind infected lands and rogue war machines. The few survivors have formed small groups, trying to start over from the remnants of the old world.

You lead one of these groups. Your task is to build a settlement from the ashes, gather resources, and provide your colonists with food, water, shelter, and safety. New survivors may join you — some will be helpful, others may bring problems.

Build, explore, defend, and make tough decisions that will shape the future of your colony.

Key Features:

  • Manage limited resources: food, water, materials, and power

  • Construct and expand your settlement in a post-apocalyptic world

  • Lead a group of survivors with unique traits and skills

  • Explore the surrounding world for resources, technologies, and new territories

  • Experience dynamic events and face the consequences of your choices

  • Defend your colony against external threats and internal dangers

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD FX4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 560 or R7 260
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Storage: 4 MB available space

short_description: A city-building strategy game with colony survival elements. After an alien invasion drained Earth’s resources, rogue machines roam the ruins. Gather resources, lead your colonists, rebuild from scratch, and fight for survival. Survive. Rebuild. Resist.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Ukrainian, German, Russian
